task.title: Define RED tests for CLI relay transport and durable send retry
task.description: Create failing Vitest specifications for a typed timeout-bound relay client plus first-send session bootstrap, immutable encrypted outbox, ambiguous-send retry, and restart behavior.
task.scope: apps/cli transport and outbound messaging tests only

acceptance_criteria: The relay client strictly validates success/error response envelopes for publish, claim, and message send and maps timeout/network/HTTP failures to typed stable errors.
Publishing sends the profile's complete signed bundle v2; a first send claims with a durable claim_id and rejects a relay bundle that differs from the imported contact pin.
First send establishes the official Signal session only after verified claim, persists exact ciphertext/outbox state atomically, and wraps it in a valid MailboxEnvelope.
A timeout after relay acceptance leaves the outbox pending; retry and process restart reuse the same message_id, envelope_id, claim_id where relevant, and byte-identical ciphertext/envelope.
Reusing a message_id with changed plaintext fails locally without a network call; successful identical replay marks the durable outbox delivered idempotently.
Tests inspect relay requests but never expose store keys, device secrets, session material, or plaintext in diagnostics/errors.
constraints: Load and follow tests-creator and the project testing skill; preserve RED-before-GREEN evidence.
Do not write implementation code or weaken existing tests.
Do not edit flow.json or acceptance-criteria.md.
Do not modify apps/relay or shared package implementation.
Use keryx ctx rg for searches and apply_patch for edits.
Use deterministic fake HTTP/fetch boundaries and real encrypted SQLite plus official Signal session objects where cryptographic/durability behavior matters.
Do not commit because the repository has an unborn untracked baseline.
Write and validate a subagent-result to .metaproject/flows/001-2026-09-05-echolet-assessment-fixes/dispatches/001-T24-tests-result.json; final response starts STATUS:.

provenance.source_request: Implement the approved Echolet CLI prototype through flow-orchestrator.
